note: Count binary words of length 2k+1 with strict H majority. There are 2^(2k) by complement symmetry. If the (k+1)-st H has exactly j T symbols before it, then its position is k+j+1; the preceding k+j positions contain k H and j T in binom(k+j,j) orders, and the remaining k-j positions are arbitrary, yielding 2^(k-j) binom(k+j,j). The cases j=0,...,k partition H-majority words, proving the target.
